reason: The PROBLEM is correct and correctly classed; the PROPOSED FIX is wrong on both halves, so the finding is refuted and re-issued as sharpenedFix. Verified against source and frames: lastFour = sum(F.weeks.slice(8)) = 6+8+5+12 = 31, priorFour = slice(4,8) = 7+5+8+6 = 26, delta +5, and F.weeks[11] (13 Jul) carries partial:true. The chip renders '+5 on the four before' with no partial mark, the band-head prints 'Last four weeks / 22 Jun to 13 Jul' from D.weeks[8].start to D.weeks[11].start — week-commencing dates read as window bounds — while the page's own stamp says 09:14, Thursday 16 July. Not already handled: the hatch, open top and '12 so far' are on the bar only; interaction-check.mjs:272 asserts exactly that and nothing about the hero, so this is not a gate restatement. Not taste: the artifact's own protected object says the current week is hatched because the week is not over, and the headline is the one place that ethic is dropped. Severity misleading holds and is not overstated — drop the running bucket and the same window reads 19 v 26 = -7, so the printed sign of the page's single answer is produced entirely by the unflagged partial week. Not blocking: the arithmetic is recoverable from the chart. WHY THE FIX FAILS. (1) The chip. Measured natural widths in the pill at every breakpoint: current text 189px; the proposed '+5 so far / this week still running' 296px; keeping the comparand, '+5 on the four before / this week still running' 387px. Free space beside the 64px numeral inside .hero-n is 216px at 1440, 216px at 1280, 224px at 390 (only 768 has room, at 482px). At 296px the pill wraps to two lines inside a flex row set to align-items:baseline, so the second line hangs off the numeral's baseline into the 'jobs finished, Harbour House weddings' note directly beneath — a break at three of the four required sizes. Worse, the proposed wording deletes 'on the four before', so the chip stops saying what the +5 is measured against; it trades one unstated fact for another. No wording carrying both the comparand and the caveat fits 216px. (2) The window label. D.readingDate does not exist. The accessor block exposes readingLong only; the reading instant lives at F.bound.readingDate as ISO '2026-07-16', which needs formatting to match the 'DD Mmm' form the weeks use. The target value '16 Jul' is right; the named source is not, and 'ending on D.readingDate' would render '2026-07-16' or undefined as written.
sharpenedFix: Keep the pill exactly as it is — 189px, one line, unchanged text — and carry the mark on the two lines that already have room. (a) Window label: add one accessor, readingShort, derived from F.bound.readingDate ('2026-07-16' -> '16 Jul') in the same DD Mmm form as w.start, and print 'Last four weeks / 22 Jun to 16 Jul'. Identical character count, zero layout cost, and the ISO date is already bound to src/lib/project-truth-fixture.ts so it cannot drift. While there, derive both bounds from the same constant that produces slice(8) rather than the hardcoded indices 8 and 11, so the label cannot desync from the sum. (b) The partial mark: when D.weeks[D.weeks.length-1].partial is true, extend the existing hero-note from 'jobs finished, Harbour House weddings' to 'jobs finished, Harbour House weddings — this week still running'. That line is t-body dim-2 at a 30ch measure, 298px wide at every breakpoint, already wraps, and needs no new colour, weight, token or pill geometry. It also fixes the accessible reading for free: the hero's current accessible name is only '31 +5 ON THE FOUR BEFORE', and hero-note is plain text, so the caveat enters the screen-reader path with no extra sr span. Gate the clause on the last bucket's partial flag, never on the state name — full, partial and quiet all call movementOne, so a state-gated clause would print wrongly in two of them.
breaks: The note grows from one line to two at 1440, 1280 and 390 (30ch measure, 298px). .hero-fig is justify-content:space-between inside a card measured at 286px tall at 1440 and 499px at 390, so the added line eats the gap to the 'Counted at the moment each job reached a done column' small print — re-measure that the two notes do not collide at 390 where the column stacks, and that the card does not grow past the chart's 168px plot. Re-measure after it lands: audit.mjs for leading and type ramp on .hero-note and for AA contrast on the extended string against the composited card; the full interaction-check.mjs, since the band-head .t-label is queried at line 210 for the denominator line and the count-up target at 529/542 asserts weeks.slice(8) sum (unchanged by this fix, but the whole gate must re-run); and all seven states, since movementOne is shared by full, partial, quiet and error while first-run renders its own D.thisWeek hero and must not gain the clause. Re-shoot all ten frames and regenerate frames.json — the label text changes in every state that renders movement one.
